title: Bow tie with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left wing of bow tie -->
  <polygon points='50,50 10,25 10,75' fill='#E63946'/>
  <polygon points='50,50 10,25 10,35 42,50' fill='#F4A261'/>
  <polygon points='50,50 10,75 10,65 42,50' fill='#F4A261'/>
  
  <!-- Right wing of bow tie -->
  <polygon points='50,50 90,25 90,75' fill='#E63946'/>
  <polygon points='50,50 90,25 90,35 58,50' fill='#F4A261'/>
  <polygon points='50,50 90,75 90,65 58,50' fill='#F4A261'/>
  
  <!-- Center knot -->
  <rect x='42' y='38' width='16' height='24' rx='5' fill='#C1121F'/>
  <rect x='44' y='40' width='5' height='20' rx='2' fill='#F4A261' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Smiling face on left wing -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <path d='M26,54 Q33,62 40,54' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#FFD166'/>
  
  <!-- Smiling face on right wing -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <path d='M60,54 Q67,62 74,54' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#FFD166'/>
  
  <!-- Center face on knot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <path d='M46,52 Q50,58 54,52' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='52' r='3' fill='#F4A261' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='52' r='3' fill='#F4A261' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
